name: config_resource_update

targetId.collection: the default configuration collection only: the Target allowlist names a resource, so a caller-supplied collection is refused with invalid_argument (a collection-qualified Target policy needs a decision)
targetId.denialCodeSource: D30 §7, Tool-scoped; the Phase 3 machinery keeps operation_disabled

verification: bounded re-read of the changed resource (Observed state). A refused or ambiguous dispatch is a success only if the resource moved in the direction this call asked for; when the requested values were already in place before dispatch nothing is attributable to this call, so an explicit Gateway refusal stays authoritative (conflict) and an ambiguous dispatch is not_applied — never a recovered success

requestSchemaValidation.schema: the resource type's documented PUT request-body item schema, bundled into a self-contained JSON Schema (internal $refs hoisted to $defs) at capability refresh time
requestSchemaValidation.appliesTo: the complete change item, before dispatch
requestSchemaValidation.unavailableDisposition: a documented update route without a usable request schema exposes no update route, so the Tool refuses the resource type with unsupported_capability
requestSchemaValidation.dependency: jsonschema (already in uv.lock via fastmcp's OpenAPI server extra)
requestSchemaValidation.snapshotImmutability: the schema is deeply immutable inside the D04 snapshot (mappings are read-only views, arrays are tuples), so a holder of the snapshot cannot change the rules a later write is validated against
requestSchemaValidation.referenceBundling: internal $refs are hoisted into $defs once per target; every occurrence keeps its own sibling keywords (a later occurrence must not lose a constraint the earlier one did not carry)

changeItem: name is included when the documented item schema declares it; a singleton's change item carries only signature plus the supplied fields
